item.title: Gunma Apple & Fruit Orchards: Mountain-Grown Autumn Harvest — Guide
item.description: Gunma’s mountainous terrain and cool climate, particularly around Numata and the northern reaches of the prefecture, create favourable conditions for growing apples and other tree fruit, earning the region recognition as one of the Kanto area’s notable fruit-growing districts. Dozens of orchards open to visitors each autumn for hands-on picking experiences, offering a range of apple varieties alongside seasonal pears, grapes and other fruit depending on the orchard and time of year, with many farms also selling fresh cider, jams and baked goods made from their harvest.
